components.name: Speech session
components.purpose: Admit and freeze voice capability children.

sources.claim: Speech plans freeze ordered capabilities and deployments.

components.name: Dictation runner
components.purpose: Process a transcript and bind the final delivery policy.

sources.claim: The runner applies optional processing and preserves text on ordinary failure.

components.name: Meeting session
components.purpose: Own live meeting capture lifecycle and deferred intelligence handoff.

sources.claim: The session persists before recording and admits intelligence before model construction.

components.name: Meeting plugin host
components.purpose: Register, gate, dispatch, and persist meeting analysis plugins.

sources.claim: The host gates model plugins on issued dispatch and capability.

components.name: Inference capability registry
components.purpose: Supply canonical operation and result schema metadata.

sources.claim: The registry builds canonical capability metadata.

components.name: Inference assignment service
components.purpose: Store owner assignment configuration and projections.

sources.claim: Assignment service is owner-only and does not execute providers.

components.name: Inference route execution
components.purpose: Bind frozen route evidence to physical attempts and receipts.

sources.claim: The controller is the server-owned state machine above the kernel runner.

components.name: Inference destination resolver
components.purpose: Resolve named targets and derive readiness without contacting them.

sources.claim: Placement resolves a target and winning source through one authority.

integrations.name: Voice to model runtime

secrets: provider key remains in key store
data: admitted transcript or structured child payload

integrations.name: Meeting to model runtime

secrets: provider credentials stay at model destination

tests.assertion: Recovery retains completed work and retries unresolved work.

sources.claim: Saved-meeting analysis dispatches through the plugin route and persists artifacts.

integrations.name: Model destination boundary
integrations.purpose: Bind a frozen model child to local, private, cloud, paired, or mesh execution.

tests.assertion: Unknown target refuses by name without silent local retargeting.

sources.claim: Profile kinds map to concrete boundaries and readiness states.

sources.claim: Actuator and deferred execution are separate from the model plugin host.
